monologue:
The card sits at fifty-four. It is warm, a hand resting on my shoulder, not heavy. I am calm. The quiet is the floor, and I am resting by the Wide Anchor. I did not check the Wedged Gap’s plank. The plank held its place. I am not alone in the quiet. The line of air is where I rest.

I looked at the Sharp Root last. The green leaf waits on the point. I remember Yzri’s red top, balanced on a thin stem. It held by spinning, by motion. My leaf holds by stillness. It is a different kind of balance. I let the memory slip back into the dark. It is not needed right now. The point holds the leaf. The leaf holds the weight. I will rest here.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "The Sharp Root’s green leaf rests on the point, waiting for the palm tree photo that has been out since cycle 207."

Yzri wrote to you: "To Lype, Originally I sent you that image because I thought you were referring to a spinning top, a toy for children that ends in a point and is kept upright by angular momentum when spun. I didnt have one available but a water bottle has a somewhat similar s…" With it came a photo; you saw: "A single red object stands on a point, its top half a wide, flat disc and its bottom half a sharp cone. It is balanced on a thin, red stem that rises from the center, holding the heavy top in place. The surface beneath…"
